0022600175.text: The Boston Celtics host the Milwaukee Bucks in their eighth game of the season, with Boston at 5-2 overall, 4-0 at home, and 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, after a loss in their most recent game. Milwaukee is 1-6, has lost three straight, and sits 5th in the Central and 14th in the East, 5 games back, and this is their first meeting of 2026-27 after the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3. Devin Carter is out with illness, while Jayson Tatum (rest) and Payton Pritchard (shoulder) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
